book.name: Yittsadhaanasa Waadimano
book.title: Kiristoos Yisa Tarjamonnante Kinin Yittsaana Eenasa Waadimano

content: Bhawloos Roome Bitaadar Kiam Yittsadhoadettsi Kinin Oysoono
Pisthoosaar yinin wottsen raqinte ardayse rooro makkam yinin wodhonsa budonte, Qesaaria katamara dhaabhayse Yerusaalem ki yivade.
Gudullasa hayonabee Ayiwd eensaar shaarira entsaynabe Bhawloosam bersan ke yedade.
“Bhawloosam Yerusaalemdar baadhoadettsi payya yer wona waadadhaa” hamayse Pisthoosam kattsi ke miskade. Ogoam kenin giyoonoar Bhawloos dhesima goynte toolayse kiam deesana kenin ooshonnane.
Pisthoosaar “Bhawloos Qesaaria katamante dhaxadhayse toldhite ki dahade; intaar saana maatayse ogote ida yive.
Yesa hayonaar imbesana kinka Qesaaria ke yive; Bhawloosin waadadhaa seeso daa ko hanna, ogote kiam ke berse” kena ki hamade.
Pisthoos rooro lankay way tabhidara sagimin kembesana kinka yinin dooqonsa budonte, Qesaaria katamandar ki yivade; kina hamon pirdin raqindar yisa dooqayse Bhawloosam kinin baadhoadettsi ki giyade.
Bhawloos nivaysaka Yerusaalemra nivaana Ayiwd eena kisa gasante woyayse kidar tarja haapadhimin thoothi detha maataa dhalqka kiam bersan ke yedade.
Bhawloosaar “Ayiwd eenasa yiggi ko dahaakaar, Barjosa gazan oonin ko dahaakaar, Roome peen bita ki dahaakaar, inin seesaa yer kala hattear qolehe” hamayse ki palimade.
Pisthoosaar Ayiwd eenaam wozisana zagayse Bhawloosna “Yerusaalem yivayse ogo dhalqinsa hana inin pirdoadettsi ya ee hamaa hamo?” hamayse kiam ki oysade.
Bhawloosaar “Inta pirdadhana zasken Roome peen bitaasa pirdin raqinsa birante woydine. Pir ya payya hayayse hanin dhesendettsi Ayiwd eendar seeso waadadhaatine.

Ta dembhina iam yeskisea seeso waadadhidi i hanna, dembhira dhaqana giyattine; ko dahaannaar igina eena iam kenin bersayno gon ko dahaamma, kena iam saskate imea eedi qolehe. ‘Roome peen bitaadar iam yittsaa’ hana ida hame” ki hamade.
Ogo wodanka Pisthoos kiam kiilayna eenabesana kinka dhalqayse, “‘Roome peen bitaadar iam yittsaa’ hanin hamonna, daran yivaada yive” kina ki hamade.
Bhawloos Agirbhabee Barniqebesa Birante Kinin Woyoono
Likka roorosa budonte, Bitaa Agirbhabee Barniqebe Pisthoosam nagaysana Qesaaria katamandar ke nivade.
Ogotear thoothi rooro kenin dooqonna, Pisthoos Bhawloossa dhalqinam yin giyayse bitaana ki giyade: “Pilkisin dhaxayse garaa eedi kalaa kote daane.
Yerusaalemir inin dohonka gudullasa hayonabee Ayiwd eensa donzanabe kidar inin pirdoadettsi iam miskada kiam ke bersade.
Intaar ‘Bersadhaa bersaynasa birante woyayse kiam bersadhonsa ki palimima saskate kiam imano Roome eenin bulaa dambitehe’ hamayse kena i maasade.
“Ogonante kiam bersayna eena bukayse kenin nivonsa, kappima kina hamon pirdi raqindar dooqayse eam baadhoadettsi i giyade.
Kiam bersanaar ke woyaysaka, ‘Kidi kattsi siya yer ki waadadhaysaka keda berse’ hamayse inin qaaborra yer kala hattear kiam pirdina yeskisea qolehe.
Ko dahaannaar kimbesana kinka kenin palimoono Ayiwd eena Barjodar woylamin kenin qajonsabee Bhawloosin ‘Sadaka daane’ kinin hamea diyaa Yesussabene.
“Intaar yerin koam marmarayse dhesana inin gaalonna Bhawloosna ‘Yerusaalem yivayse ogote hasa dhalqinna pirdadhoadettsi ya ee hamaw?’ kina i hamade.
Bhawloosaar ‘Isa dhalqinam Roome peen bitaanin shedenka yekka, dhaxin ooninte i dooqe’ kinin hamonna, bitaakal kiam inin yittsenka yekka, dhaxin ooninte kinin doadettsi i giyade” kina ki hamade.
Agirbhaar Pisthoosna “Intaar ea agaanin giyenam inti qansana ida zage” ki hamade. Pisthoosaar “Saka kinin giyenam qansaada qanse” kina ki hamade.

Ogona kina hamon Agirbhabee Barniqebe gebhi gobshika nivayse shii alaqanabee katamante dahaana gembha eenabesana kinka pirdi ooninte ke ardade. Pisthoosaar “Ki baadhe” hamayse ki giyaysaka, Bhawloosam ko baadhade.

Pisthoosaar yi giyna: “Bitaa Agirbhabee yediar wombesana kinka dahaana eena wulbe, ‘Keeda kaara os sadaka daa kiam zaskehe’ hamayse ilatada Ayiwd eena wul Yerusaalembee kotebe kidar pirdadhoadettsi iam kenin miskaa ea kaane.
Intaar dembhina kiam yeskisea yer kinin hayaamonam i haapade. Kidiar ‘Roome peen bitaadar iam yittsaa’ kinin hamonna, kiam bitaadar yittsana qaabayse i woysade.

Kinnon goynsa isa bitaakal inin thaapea gon hama yer qolehe. Ogonante kiam marmardhonsa budonte, yer inin thaapea ina haapadhasane hamayse, yesa birante, kattsika Bitaa Agirbha, hasa birante kiam entsate i nivade.
Harrna hambhidianna, dhaxadhaa eam yittsadhenka kiam bersadhonsa warqat thaapayse kanka yittsadhaammo yer malgimmakko ina ko maatade” ki hamade.
